purpose: Review-gated candidate register for Australian regulatory/code/standard sources potentially applicable to Watch Tower engineering. Source currency does not establish project applicability or compliance.
guardrails: An official standard marked Current is not automatically applicable to WT-001.
NCC legal effect and adoption are jurisdiction-specific; do not assume NCC 2025 applies without the authorised project jurisdiction and its adoption state.
Building classification, importance level, design working life and special-structure treatment remain professional/regulatory decisions.
Referenced-standard editions must be reconciled against the actually applicable NCC/jurisdiction and project approval basis before engineering use.
No load, factor, acceptance threshold, compliance or certification result is created by this register.
